<rect class="box focus" x="20" y="32" width="320" height="96" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="34" y="56" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">① Semantic Abstract Schema</text>
<text class="label" x="34" y="78" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">semantic-schema-core/</text>
<text class="label" x="34" y="96" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">semantic-abstract-schema@v1</text>
<text class="note" x="34" y="116" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">Core が持つ</text>
<rect class="box" x="356" y="32" width="524" height="96" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="370" y="56" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">スキーマが守ること</text>
<text class="note" x="370" y="78" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">根に title と description を書く ・ 欄ごとに description と x-prompt を書く</text>
<text class="note" x="370" y="96" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">データを指す欄は x-relationship で書く</text>

<text class="note" x="192" y="154" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">Scaffold で雛形を作り、$schema で指して従う</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="20" y="172" width="320" height="96" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="34" y="196" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">② Semantic Concrete Schema</text>
<text class="label" x="34" y="218" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">brainstorming/board@v1</text>
<text class="note" x="34" y="256" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">Skill ・ Agent が持つ</text>
<rect class="box" x="356" y="172" width="524" height="96" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="370" y="196" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">データが守ること</text>
<text class="note" x="370" y="218" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">ボードは topics を持ち、論点は id ・ question ・ answer を持つ</text>
<text class="note" x="370" y="236" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">depends は topics の id を指す（x-relationship）</text>
<path class="flow" d="M180,270 V308" fill="none" stroke="#5B6B66" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#dsvg-adafe2ca-arrow-5B6B66)"/>
<text class="note" x="192" y="294" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">Scaffold で雛形を作り、$schema で指して従う</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="20" y="312" width="320" height="96" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="34" y="336" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">③ instance</text>
<text class="label" x="34" y="358" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">.brainstorming/</text>
<text class="label" x="34" y="376" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">semantic-contract-core.json</text>
<text class="note" x="34" y="396" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">文脈がコミットする</text>
<rect class="box" x="356" y="312" width="524" height="96" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="370" y="336" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">実際の値</text>
<text class="note" x="370" y="358" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">Q6 の question は「Semantic Abstract Schema を…」</text>
<text class="note" x="20" y="436" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">②は③から見ればスキーマで、①から見れば①に従う1件のデータである（Concrete は Abstract の instance でもある）</text>
</svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 1050 456" style="min-width:900px" role="img" aria-label="schema-driven で起きたことと、Semantic Schema Core でそれを起こさない決まり" class="dsvg"><style data-dsvg="dark">.dsvg .canvas{fill:var(--dsvg-area-fill,#FFFFFF)}.dsvg .note{fill:var(--dsvg-ink-soft,#5B6B66);font-size:11px}.dsvg .box{fill:var(--dsvg-box-fill,#F3F7F5);stroke:var(--dsvg-accent,#0D5C55)}.dsvg .label{fill:var(--dsvg-ink,#111D1A);font-size:12px}@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .dsvg,.dsvg:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--dsvg-area-fill:#22302D;--dsvg-ink-soft:#9DADA8;--dsvg-box-fill:#16211E;--dsvg-accent:#6CC9B8;--dsvg-ink:#E6EEEB}}:root[data-theme="dark"] .dsvg{--dsvg-area-fill:#22302D;--dsvg-ink-soft:#9DADA8;--dsvg-box-fill:#16211E;--dsvg-accent:#6CC9B8;--dsvg-ink:#E6EEEB}</style><rect data-dsvg="canvas" class="canvas" x="0.0" y="0.0" width="1050.0" height="456.0" fill="#FFFFFF" rx="8"/>
<text class="note" x="20" y="22" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">schema-driven で起きたこと（参考の事実）</text>
<text class="note" x="458" y="22" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5B6B66">Semantic Schema Core の決まり</text>
<rect class="box" x="16" y="32" width="430" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="26" y="57" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">どの一員も、自分は Concrete スキーマとして</text>
<text class="label" x="26" y="74" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">書かれていた</text>
<rect class="box" x="454" y="32" width="580" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="464" y="57" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">準拠と所有を分ける。どの一員も meta-schema に準拠し、</text>
<text class="label" x="464" y="74" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">所有は名前の頭（semantic-schema-core/）で示す</text>
<rect class="box" x="16" y="96" width="430" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="26" y="121" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">自分の検査で13件の指摘が出た</text>
<rect class="box" x="454" y="96" width="580" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="464" y="121" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Core の一員も自分の検査から除外せず、description と</text>
<text class="label" x="464" y="138" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">x-prompt を持つ（手元の形には x-prompt を求めない）</text>
<rect class="box" x="16" y="160" width="430" height="41" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="26" y="185" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">注釈の一覧がメタスキーマ（5）とコード（7）で違った</text>
<rect class="box" x="454" y="160" width="580" height="41" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="464" y="185" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Core の x- は Abstract の中に1つずつ定義し、コードはそれを読む</text>
<rect class="box" x="16" y="207" width="430" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="26" y="232" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">annotations ・ view と meta-schema を</text>
<text class="label" x="26" y="249" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">つなぐのがコードだけだった</text>
<rect class="box" x="454" y="207" width="580" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="464" y="232" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">本体が annotations を $ref で指す。</text>
<text class="label" x="464" y="249" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">view の形は本体の $defs に置く</text>
<rect class="box" x="16" y="271" width="430" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="26" y="296" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">データを指すキーワードに置いた label を、</text>
<text class="label" x="26" y="313" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">どのコードも読まなかった</text>
<rect class="box" x="454" y="271" width="580" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="464" y="296" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">名前の出どころは x-view の label の1か所にする</text>
<rect class="box" x="16" y="335" width="430" height="41" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="26" y="360" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">公開の記録が無いまま abstract@v1 を配った</text>
<rect class="box" x="454" y="335" width="580" height="41" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="464" y="360" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">最初の公開から公開の記録を付け、出した版は変えない</text>
<rect class="box" x="16" y="382" width="430" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="26" y="407" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">データを指すキーワードの名前が、</text>
<text class="label" x="26" y="424" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">$ref（スキーマを指す）と紛れた</text>
<rect class="box" x="454" y="382" width="580" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="464" y="407" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">データを指すキーワードは x-relationship と呼び、</text>
<text class="label" x="464" y="424" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">存在の検査と inverse の意味を description に書く</text>
</svg>
Core の x- と検証の振り分け
Core の x- と rule の欄ごとの、定義の置き場所 ・ Concrete で書く場所 ・ 検証の種類 ・ validator ・ 検証すること。Concrete が足した x- は作法だけを見る。
